    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    object_row = next(row for row in grid if sum(v != bg for v in row) > 1)
